fact: Statistician-General says Stats SA depends on SITA for network connectivity, transversal systems (Persal, BAS, LOGIS) and hosting under a contract running July 2022 to June 2025, while most optional services such as software development are provided internally or acquired outside SITA.
title: Question NW1853 to the Minister in the Presidency
publisher: Parliamentary Monitoring Group (reply by Statistics South Africa)
